post_freeze_addenda.status: exploratory; not part of frozen protocol
post_freeze_addenda.scope: Raw versus Holm-adjusted placebo reporting; zero-return variants; factor-aligned direction null; H2 sensitivity grid, refit-aware uncertainty, EWMA and fixed-alert metrics; 17-industry aggregation check; F subperiod analysis; and lambda sensitivity.
post_freeze_addenda.effect_on_frozen_definitions: none; the original analysis plan, protocol hash, primary results, and frozen verdicts are retained unchanged

post_freeze_addenda.scope: Compare paired H2 circular-bootstrap interval estimates using 60-, 125-, and 250-session blocks, with 399 replicates per length, as an exploratory bandwidth check.
post_freeze_addenda.effect_on_frozen_definitions: none; the extension adds a sensitivity analysis and leaves frozen H2 estimates and verdict unchanged

post_freeze_addenda.scope: Compute the original date-wise Haar percentile and add a 250-session circular-block interval and autocorrelation-adjusted effective sample size over 1000 replicates.
post_freeze_addenda.effect_on_frozen_definitions: none; the extension summarizes serial-dependence uncertainty without changing the Haar draws, frozen statistic, or verdicts

post_freeze_addenda.scope: Rerun only F's primary, 1e-6 floor, zeros-as-missing, subperiod, and four-value lambda-grid block-shuffle comparisons with 4,999 draws. Retain existing valid R/H raw probabilities and recompute their Holm family adjustments with the new F probability.
post_freeze_addenda.effect_on_frozen_definitions: none; this changes post-freeze Monte Carlo resolution only and does not alter frozen results, protocol, thresholds, or verdicts
